home.heroTitle:
A Sanctuary of Peace,
Rooted in Heritage
home.heroSubtitle: Kalatuwagama Rajamaha Viharaya has guided this community in Dhamma, education and service for generations.
home.introText: Under one spiritual home, the temple, the Sunday Dhamma school and the community foundation work together — preserving tradition while serving the needs of today.
home.org1Text: An ancient temple preserving centuries of Buddhist heritage, daily rituals and a resident community of monks.
home.org2Text: Sunday Dhamma education for children — building character, values and understanding of the Buddha's teachings.
home.org3Text: A community foundation running blood donation camps, educational aid and welfare projects for those in need.
home.eventsSubtitle: Join us for these upcoming religious observances and community programs.
home.donationsText: Your contribution sustains temple upkeep, Daham Pasala education and the foundation's welfare projects.
